findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aiapplyd_search_jobs · Private data: aiapplyd_build_pdf · Public sink: aiapplyd_translate_resume · Destructive: aiapplyd_update_job_preferences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aiapplyd_search_jobs · Private data: aiapplyd_build_pdf · Public sink: aiapplyd_translate_resume · Destructive: aiapplyd_update_job_preferences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
